resolved_items.item: Nonvacuity, parameter scope, and purported strength
resolved_items.resolution: The claim is nonvacuous: K = rho = 1 and p(x,t) = u(x,t) = x-t satisfy every bundled premise and yield the nonconstant mode 2(x-t). Positive ratio excludes zero density and nonpositive radicands. Allowing both-negative parameters does not warrant faithful-stronger: the printed mathematical condition concerns the positive ratio, and even under a physical-positive reading negative pairs reduce to positive pairs by K' = -K, rho' = -rho, p' = p, u' = -u, preserving the ratio, acoustic equations, and constructed mode.
